writesMeaning: True when the tool can submit an on-chain transaction.

journalEffects.read: Reads existing proposal records. Opening the journal can initialize local storage.
journalEffects.propose: May save a simulated proposal locally.
journalEffects.execute: May reserve a signed transaction and record its outcome locally.
journalEffects.reconcile: May record a confirmed outcome and release the pending nonce locally.

tools.name: sentinel_get_portfolio
tools.description: Value the configured account in test USD, separating idle funds and stored lending exposure.
guarantees: Values the configured 1952 account using fresh mock oracle prices at the verified block.
Reports idle assets, stored supply and debt separately in test USD.

tools.name: sentinel_get_positions
tools.description: Read raw token holdings, pToken shares, underlying supplied and stored borrow balances.
guarantees: Reads token balances and lending-book snapshots for the configured account at the same verified block.

tools.name: sentinel_get_markets
tools.description: Read activated state, caps, policy IDs and liquidity for manifest-listed v1 markets.
guarantees: Reads the markets in the 1952 manifest and checks each controller’s books against its manifest addresses.

tools.name: sentinel_get_rates
tools.description: Read variable per-block rates and model-based simple annual rates at the same block.
guarantees: Checks the configured rate model and calculates simple APR using its on-chain blocksPerYear and each book’s per-block rate.

tools.name: sentinel_get_policies
tools.description: Read the market and account policy IDs and their actual registry entries.
guarantees: Reads the attached market and account policy IDs and returns their registry entries at the verified block. A zero ID has a null entry.

tools.name: sentinel_get_strategies
tools.description: Read the configured automatic repayment trigger, repay-only operator grant, expiry and budget.
guarantees: Reports the actual trigger and grant for the fixed operator. A live repay-only grant requires mask 8, a positive budget and an unexpired grant.

tools.name: sentinel_simulate_auto_repay
tools.description: Simulate autoRepay() for the configured testnet operator through a read-only eth_call.
guarantees: Checks the repay-only grant, trigger and mock price freshness before simulating autoRepay as the fixed operator.
An eligible amount is positive and within the observed grant.

tools.name: sentinel_propose_auto_repay
tools.description: Simulate and persist a five-minute proposal scoped to the configured account, operator and grant.
guarantees: Only an eligible simulation produces a saved proposal. The proposal binds the account, operator, grant, amount and block for five minutes.

tools.name: sentinel_execute_auto_repay
tools.description: Submit one locally proposed v1 testnet autoRepay() or reconcile its original hash. Requires explicit operator signer enablement.
guarantees: Requires an enabled dedicated operator and a local proposal. Rechecks the grant and simulated amount before signing a zero-value autoRepay call to the configured 1952 account.
Reserves the hash and nonce before submission. An uncertain submission can be reconciled by its original ID.

tools.name: sentinel_quote
tools.description: Request an informational OKX OnchainOS WOKB/native USDC mainnet quote. Returns unavailable when credentials or service are missing.
guarantees: Requests an informational OKX quote for WOKB and native USDC on chain 196. Missing credentials or an unavailable provider return a blocked status and null quote.

tools.name: sentinel_simulate_operator_borrow
tools.description: Simulate the fixed operator borrowing one mock dollar on 1952 and return the actual decoded contract decision.
guarantees: Simulates borrowing 1,000,000 raw mUSD units as the configured operator. Reports the observed contract result through eth_call.

tools.name: sentinel_get_execution_receipt
tools.description: Read the canonical receipt and account changes for a specific previously submitted local proposal.
guarantees: Looks up the submitted hash by local proposal ID. For a confirmed repayment, checks the canonical transaction and both the account and debt-book events.
